# RouteLocation v1.2.20

### 繁體中文

- 改善原生「貼上」控制項在剪貼簿或 App 狀態切換後的恢復可靠性。
- 貼上維持純文字支援；貼上的文字仍可由座標解析器辨識座標或 Google Maps 連結。
- 鍵盤彈出時，座標輸入視窗會維持穩定位置。

### English

- Improved recovery of the native Paste control after clipboard or app lifecycle changes.
- Paste remains plain-text only; pasted text can still contain coordinates or a Google Maps link understood by the coordinate parser.
- The coordinate-entry modal now stays in a stable position when the keyboard appears.

Re-sign the unsigned IPA with SideStore, AltStore, TrollStore, or another compatible tool.
